**Finding: compliant (preferred position).**

- **§ 12.3** expressly negates any restrictive covenant on us: nothing restricts Customer from developing, acquiring, licensing, selling or using any product or service, or conducting business in any field or territory, and Vendor acknowledges no exclusivity or non-compete commitment.
- **§ 12.4** is the mirror image — it restricts *Vendor* from competing with our analytics products — so it benefits us and is not flagged.
- **§ 2.1** confirms no minimum quantity or purchase commitment; **§ 13.4** contains only ordinary acceptable-use limits (reverse engineering, interference, security bypass), which are not field-of-use or competitive restrictions.

No redline proposed.
